extracted.intended_audience: Authors of preprints previously recommended by Peer Community In (PCI) who are submitting to Mathematical Modelling of Natural Phenomena (MMNP)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for authors whose preprint has been recommended by Peer Community In (PCI) on how to prepare their manuscript, what to include at submission, and how MMNP will treat PCI recommendations during review and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a 'Peer review' section to the article
rubrics_metrics.description: If your article was previously recommended by PCI, please add a section at the end of your article, before the references, titled Peer review, with the link to the PCI recommendations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Include a discrete section titled 'Peer review' immediately before the references. The page provides an explicit example citation block that should be used or adapted, showing the recommended article citation and the DOI link to the PCI recommendation (example given for a MedrXiv preprint and its PCI DOI). Example text from the page:

Peer review
A preprint of this article on MedrXiv has been reviewed and recommended by Peer Community in Mathematical and Computational Biology:  Bastien Reyné, Quentin Richard, Camille Noûs, Christian Selinger, Mircea T. Sofonea, Ramsès Djidjou-Demasse, Samuel Alizon (2022). Non-Markovian modelling highlights the importance of age structure on Covid-19 epidemiological dynamics. Peer Community in Mathematical and Computational Biology, https://doi.org/10.24072/pci.mcb.100008

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate availability of PCI reviewer recommendations at submission (Editorial Manager)
rubrics_metrics.description: At the time of submission you should indicate that PCI reviewer recommendations are available: respond to the author question in Editorial Manager and provide the DOI of the PCI recommendation in the corresponding field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the PCI recommendation DOI in the exact format requested: https://doi.org/10.24072/pci.mcb.xxxxxx. This is a required metadata entry during submission so the editorial office can locate the PCI recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include PCI recommendation information in the cover letter
rubrics_metrics.description: When submitting, include information that PCI recommendations exist in your cover letter addressed to the Editor in charge of your article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state in the cover letter that the preprint was recommended by PCI and give the DOI/link to the PCI recommendation. This supplements the Editorial Manager field and helps the handling editor recognize available reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential use of PCI reviews during MMNP peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: If the recommended article falls within the scope, the journal might use the PCI reviews and recommendation to strengthen or speed up the usual peer-review process of your article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No guarantee is given, but authors should expect that PCI reviews may be consulted or incorporated to accelerate handling. Authors should therefore ensure PCI materials are clearly linked and formatted so editors can easily assess and reuse them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication will include link to PCI recommendations upon acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: If your article is accepted for publication in MMNP, a link to the PCI recommendations will be added alongside your published article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors do not need to take further action post-acceptance for the link to be displayed; the journal will add the PCI recommendation link to the published article page.
